title: Crying Toddler Girl Holding Large Doll Outdoors, 1960s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A candid outdoor snapshot from the mid-1960s capturing a distressed toddler girl crying while clutching a large doll with textured curly hair. She is dressed in a light-colored A-line pinafore dress over a long-sleeved shirt, paired with white socks and Mary Jane style shoes. In the background, lush garden foliage, a monstera leaf, and the roofline of a mid-century home are visible under bright sunlight, with a horizontal light flare passing through the upper middle of the frame.
